Former fighter and analyst Dan Hardy headlines Rogan's MMA Show number 178. Hardy, nicknamed the Outlaw, fought for a world title. He now breaks down fights with a coach's eye.

Rogan and Hardy review styles, matchups, and fine technique. The British guest explains what casual fans often miss. They discuss how fighters game-plan for each foe. The episode is a technical treat for serious fans. Hardy turns hard fights into clear lessons, and Rogan keeps him teaching at full depth for the whole show. Few analysts teach the sport half as clearly.
